title.bn: নির্দিষ্ট ও বিকল্প পথের ফাইনাইট অটোমেটা

summary.en: Define finite automata, read transition tables and diagrams, and simulate deterministic and nondeterministic paths.
summary.bn: ফাইনাইট অটোমেটার সংজ্ঞা, টেবিল ও চিত্র বোঝো এবং নির্দিষ্ট ও বিকল্প পথ অনুসরণ করো।

notes: Implementations were run with Python 3.12.14 and use only the standard library.

sections.title: Define a DFA and an NFA
Simulate one state or a set

examples.title: DFA for even b count
examples.explanationHtml: The empty string and bb accept. b rejects because its parity is odd. abx rejects because x is not in the alphabet.

examples.title: A transition trace ending in b
examples.explanationHtml: The two a symbols leave state A unchanged. The last b reaches final B. This machine remembers the last symbol, not b parity.

examples.title: Set simulation of an NFA
examples.explanationHtml: ab and aab leave final state 2 active. aba loses that completed path on its final a and therefore rejects.

practice.title: Even b words
practice.statementHtml: Read one word per line, including an empty line. Print ACCEPT when it contains only a and b and has an even b count; otherwise print REJECT.
hints: Represent parity with E and O.

practice.title: Words ending in ab
practice.statementHtml: Read words over a and b, one per line. Print YES if each word ends in ab, otherwise NO. Any other character also gives NO. Implement the three-state DFA rather than a suffix method.
hints: Remember no suffix, a suffix a, or a suffix ab.

practice.title: Five-part model
practice.statementHtml: State Q, Σ, δ, q0, and F for the even-b recogniser.
practice.answerHtml: Q={E,O}; Σ={a,b}; q0=E; F={E}. δ(E,a)=E, δ(E,b)=O, δ(O,a)=O, δ(O,b)=E. Every state-symbol pair has one destination.

practice.title: Trace an NFA prefix
practice.statementHtml: Using the ending-ab NFA, trace ab and aba with complete active sets.
hints: Union all outgoing destinations after each character.
practice.answerHtml: Start {0}; after a, {0,1}; after b, {0,2}, so ab accepts. After another a, {0,1}, which has no final 2, so aba rejects.

practice.title: Prove the parity invariant
practice.statementHtml: Explain why E represents even b count after every prefix.
hints: Use the start and the two possible next characters.
practice.answerHtml: Initially zero b symbols is even, matching E. Reading a changes neither count parity nor state. Reading b toggles count parity and toggles E/O. Induction on prefix length therefore proves the invariant, and accepting only E gives the required language.

quiz.prompt: What does the state E remember in the parity machine?
quiz.explanation: The state stores parity rather than the full count.
options: An even b count so far

quiz.prompt: What does the DFA transition function return?
quiz.explanation: A complete DFA has exactly one destination per state and alphabet symbol.
options: Always a set of two states

quiz.explanation: Nondeterminism keeps alternatives; one successful full path suffices.
options: At least one complete path ends final
Any prefix visits a final state
The largest state number is reached

quiz.prompt: Is ε accepted by the even-b machine?
quiz.explanation: The start E is final because zero is even.
options: No, because no symbol was read
Only if an a is added
Only if the alphabet is empty

quiz.prompt: Which model recognises more languages, DFA or NFA?
options: Neither; they recognise the same class

quiz.prompt: What is the active-set update for an epsilon-free NFA?
quiz.explanation: Only next destinations survive; past states do not remain unless reached again.
options: Keep every previously visited state forever
Union of all current states’ destinations

quiz.prompt: Why reject abx in the parity interface?
quiz.explanation: The table defines only a and b input transitions.
options: x is outside the declared alphabet
b count can never be even

quiz.prompt: What final parity label follows the word bab?
quiz.explanation: Two b symbols toggle twice, ending even.

quiz.prompt: Does a final state matter before all input has been read?
quiz.explanation: Three toggles finish in O, regardless of earlier visits to E.

quiz.prompt: How many NFA states survive unioning these two destination sets?
quiz.explanation: Set union retains 0, 1, and 2 once each.

quiz.prompt: Which simulation cost holds for a fixed DFA table and input length n?
quiz.explanation: One lookup occurs per character; only the current state is retained.
options: O(n) time and constant state memory

keyPoints.en: A state summarises the relevant input history.
keyPoints.bn: স্টেট আগের ইনপুটের দরকারি তথ্য ধরে রাখে।

keyPoints.en: A complete DFA has one destination for every state-symbol pair.
keyPoints.bn: সম্পূর্ণ DFA-তে প্রতি স্টেট ও অক্ষরের জোড়ায় একটি গন্তব্য থাকে।

keyPoints.en: An NFA transition returns a set of destinations.
keyPoints.bn: NFA-এর ট্রানজিশনে এক সেট গন্তব্য পাওয়া যায়।

keyPoints.en: Acceptance is checked after consuming the whole word.
keyPoints.bn: পুরো শব্দ পড়ার পর গ্রহণ করা হবে কি না দেখি।

keyPoints.en: DFA and NFA recognise the same regular languages.
keyPoints.bn: DFA আর NFA একই রেগুলার ভাষাগুলো চিনতে পারে।

keyPoints.en: The empty word is accepted exactly when the initial configuration accepts.
keyPoints.bn: খালি শব্দ গ্রহণ হবে কি না তা শুরুর অবস্থাই বলে দেয়।

examQuestions.question: Compare DFA and NFA definitions, acceptance, and simulation costs.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A complete DFA maps each state-symbol pair to one destination and tracks one state. An NFA maps the pair to a set and accepts if some full path ends final. Set simulation avoids enumerating paths individually, but can track many states. Both recognise regular languages.
